decisions.rationale: The profile reports row_count 166158 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe step is applied.

year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin, dest, and sched_dep_time all have null_rate 0.0 and together identify one scheduled departure; carrier plus flight alone cannot, since the same flight number can operate multiple departures per day, so the scheduled departure time and route disambiguate. The reviewer should verify uniqueness against the warehouse before approval.

dep_time and dep_delay are null at rate 0.029388 (4883 rows) and arr_time/arr_delay/air_time at rates up to 0.032981; these rows represent cancelled or incomplete flights, are retained with nulls, and are surfaced via the derived is_cancelled boolean rather than dropped or imputed.
All numeric columns landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every profiled sample and distinct value is integral (counts, minutes, HHMM clock encodings), so they are cast to INTEGER losslessly.
time_hour samples are uniformly ISO-8601 UTC strings (2013-01-01T10:00:00Z and similar) with null_rate 0.0, supporting a strict cast to TIMESTAMP.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata: true and carry only load mechanics (_airbyte_meta is uniformly '{}'), so all three are dropped.

dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time span 1.0 to 2400.0, consistent with HHMM clock encoding; they are cast to INTEGER but deliberately not converted to TIME types, since 2400.0 is not a valid TIME value and the conversion would need business sign-off.

purpose: Cleaned flight-level record of the 166,158 departures from the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in January through June 2013, typed from Airbyte-landed decimals and strings into native integers and timestamps. It feeds on-time performance analysis, carrier and route reporting, and downstream gold aggregates.
usage: One row per scheduled departure, keyed by year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin, dest, and sched_dep_time. Consumers computing delay or air-time statistics must deliberately filter out cancelled flights using is_cancelled (or equivalently dep_time IS NOT NULL), since roughly 2.9% of rows carry null actuals. Note that dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time are HHMM-encoded integers (e.g. 517 means 05:17), not minutes or TIME values; time_hour is the proper TIMESTAMP for joins to hourly data.
limitations: Covers only 2013 months 1-6 and NYC origins. Cancelled or incomplete flights leave dep_time/dep_delay null at rate 0.029388 and arr_time at 0.0307, with arr_delay and air_time null at 0.032981; these nulls are retained, not imputed. tailnum is null for 0.9% of rows (1521), and one sample (D942DN) does not follow the N-prefixed US registration pattern, suggesting occasional malformed tail numbers that this cleanup does not correct. HHMM clock columns were not converted to TIME types because the observed max of 2400 is outside the valid TIME range.
